title: Best-Rate Guarantee Terms Carried by Each Hotel Rate Plan
content:
Whether a plan of the Hotel Rate Plans range carries the best-rate guarantee, how long the claim window runs and what goodwill is added to an upheld claim are contracted as follows.

| Rate plan | Guarantee carried | Claim window, hours from booking | Goodwill added |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | no | 0 | 0.00 USD |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | no | 0 | 0.00 USD |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | yes | 24 | 25.00 USD |
| Standard Flexible Rate | yes | 24 | 25.00 USD |
| Member Flex Rate | yes | 48 | 50.00 USD |
| Suite Flexible Rate | yes | 48 | 50.00 USD |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 72 | 100.00 USD |

The first column records whether a lower public rate found elsewhere is settled rather than refused. The second is the number of hours after booking within which such a rate may be claimed. The third is the goodwill amount added to an upheld claim.

*Boundary reading, hypothetical hours.* On the Member Flex Rate the window is 48 hours: a lower public rate found 47 hours after booking falls inside it, and one found 49 hours after booking does not. Two plans of the range carry no guarantee at all — the Non-Refundable Saver Rate and the Advance Purchase 21 Rate — and both accordingly show a window of 0 hours and goodwill of 0.00 USD.
